VNET Group (VNET) reported a loss of $0.01 per share on revenue of $442.01 million for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.53 per share on revenue of $441.85 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 101.89% while revenue grew 21.88% on a year-over-year basis.
